opening.argument: The offer ties commissions and cycle bonuses directly to recruiting purchasers and buying multiple paid positions. It promises a 15-point cycle completion bonus when three or more people buy momentum packs, while also urging viewers to obtain as many packs and bulk packages as possible. The sales pitch then highlights earning potential of up to $9,840 per position and a total potential exceeding five million dollars, presenting unusually large automated returns alongside the matrix structure. It separately promotes automated AI trading with daily compounding, and the speaker closes with a direct instruction to take action and build a portfolio. These features establish active solicitation built around recruitment, paid packages, and extraordinary earning claims.
